Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema

Class ForeignKeyInfo

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.ForeignKeyInfo
public final class ForeignKeyInfo extends Object
One foreign key of a table as the database reports it, from Schema.foreignKeys(String).

Actions are the database's lower-case words, such as cascade or no action. Instances are immutable.
